children: Anthropic committed to spend at least $47.2 billion, and up to $49.2 billion, on Microsoft Azure from November 2026 through June 2033, regardless of usage.
Microsoft will use Intel Foundry’s EMIB chip-packaging technology in Azure, becoming its first customer. The deal also includes Xeon processors and next-gen server systems, including Diamond Rapids.
Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) is buying about $1 billion of non-voting shares in Anthropic as part of Anthropic’s $26 billion placement, at an IPO price of $83 per share.
Microsoft (MSFT) and Danaher will build AI lab tools on Azure and Microsoft Foundry. First commercial products are expected in 2026, with more agent-enabled instruments planned for 2027.
Microsoft expanded Copilot across Office and launched Copilot Workspaces. BNP Paribas estimates Copilot reaches 8% of Microsoft 365 users globally; a reseller reports 20% seat usage in its region.
Microsoft introduced Agent 365, a management layer for enterprise AI agents, and is increasingly using its own models in Copilot. It also touted MAI Code 2’s performance and cost.

Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) said its Cobalt 200 virtual machines offer up to 50% better performance than Cobalt 100. Availability is expected to expand from 14 Azure regions to 23 by the end of 2026.
Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) software was disrupted by a series of technology outages that began November 11.
Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) partnered with Salesforce on Copilotforce, connecting Salesforce data and workflows with Microsoft Copilot, Teams, and Fabric.
Rep. Thomas H. Kean Jr. disclosed selling $15,000 to $50,000 of Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) stock on Oct. 27.
